The number beside a group is the number of session(s) that link's page reports matched. Sources this build does not classify sit under <i>ungrouped</i> and are still filterable on their own.</p>

<section id=export-cli>
<h2>Export this view (CLI)</h2>
<p>The same filters this page applied, spelled as <code>chat-stasher export</code> flags, ready to copy.</p>
<pre>chat-stasher export --destination dest-under-test --machine m-1 --out ~/out</pre>
<p class=sub>Running it writes one file per selected session under <code>--out</code> — <code>&lt;out&gt;/&lt;machine&gt;/&lt;harness&gt;/&lt;session-id&gt;.jsonl</code>, and <code>--out</code> must name a new or empty directory — byte-identical to what <code>chat-stasher read</code> returns for that session, and <code>--dry-run</code> prints what it will do before it does any of it. One session needs no command: its session page offers a <b>download .jsonl</b> link whose bytes are exactly <code>read</code>'s, with the same digest the command prints riding the response as <code>X-Checksum-Sha256</code>.</p>
</section>
<footer>
<p><b>Metadata tier.</b> This page was rendered from one archive-metadata read taken before the server started (snapshots + index + tree + the activity sidecar). The only conversation text it holds is each session's one-line label — at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index, which rode that same metadata read. 0 session shard blob(s) were fetched by that read — a session's full conversation is fetched only when you click it and then click <i>load</i>, and the cost is shown before you do.</p>
<p>Machines are named by their archive partition id, which is the key the repository actually partitions on. Times are UTC. No JavaScript, no external asset, no off-host link is loaded by this page.</p>
<p><b>This server is on 127.0.0.1, which is not a security boundary</b> — any other program on this machine can connect to it. Access is gated only by the random token in this page's URL. Do not share the URL. The server exits by itself when idle.</p>
</footer>
